title: About CertNorth
description: Who we are, why CertNorth exists, how we research and verify every figure, and how we make money — stated plainly.
bodyHtml:
CertNorth is an independent guide to project management certifications and careers. We are not a training provider, we do not sell courses or exam prep, and we have no commercial relationship with PMI, Scrum.org, the Scrum Alliance, or any other certifying body. That independence is the whole point of the site.

Why this site exists

Most advice about project management certifications is written by the companies selling the training. That doesn't make it false, but it does make it one-sided: a training provider has little reason to tell you that a certification is overpriced, that a cheaper alternative is better value, or that you shouldn't buy anything yet. We are free to say all three, and we do.

You will find sentences on this site like "who this certification is not for", and comparisons where our conclusion is that the more expensive option buys you teaching rather than prestige. That is the kind of guidance we wanted to read when trying to make sense of this field, and could not find.

How we research

Every price, eligibility rule, and renewal requirement comes from the certifying body itself — PMI, Scrum.org, the Scrum Alliance, PeopleCert, ICAgile — and we link the source so you can check it. Salary figures come from official labour-market statistics where they exist, such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, and from named commercial sources where they don't.

When official data doesn't exist, we say so rather than dressing up an estimate. Scrum Master and Product Owner, for example, have no government occupation code anywhere, so every salary figure for those roles is self-reported to a commercial aggregator. We tell you that instead of quoting one number confidently.

Certification prices and rules change — PMI updated the PMP exam in July 2026, for instance. We re-verify the volatile figures on a schedule, and we record the month each one was last checked. We never bump a date to look fresh without actually revising the content.

Who writes CertNorth

Articles are researched, written, and published by the CertNorth editorial team. We compile and verify from official primary sources rather than claiming personal credentials we don't hold — and because we name the source for every fact, you never have to take our word for anything. If we get something wrong, we correct it and say what changed.

How we make money

Some links to courses and exam-prep tools earn us a commission at no extra cost to you, and the site may display advertising. Neither ever changes a ranking or a verdict. When we conclude that something isn't worth buying, that conclusion stands whether or not there is a commission attached — and you'll find plenty of those conclusions here.

Corrections and contact

If you spot an error, or a price that has changed since we last checked, please tell us — we would rather be corrected than be wrong. You can reach us at {{email}}.

title: Privacy Policy
description: How CertNorth handles data, cookies, and advertising, including Google AdSense, affiliate links, and your choices.
bodyHtml:
Last updated: July 2026.

This Privacy Policy explains how CertNorth ("we", "us") handles information when you visit our website. We keep data collection to a minimum and we do not sell your personal information.

Information we collect

CertNorth is a content website. You do not need to create an account or submit personal information to read our guides. If you contact us by email, we receive only the information you choose to share (such as your name and email address), solely to reply to you.

Cookies and similar technologies

Like most websites, CertNorth and its partners may use cookies — small files stored on your device — to remember preferences (such as light or dark theme) and to measure and improve the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work as intended.

Advertising and Google AdSense

We may display ads served by Google AdSense. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites.

  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this site and/or other sites on the internet.
  • You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.
  • You can also opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies at aboutads.info/choices.

Affiliate links

Some of our certification and course articles contain affiliate links. If you click one and sign up or buy, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Affiliate relationships never change our rankings or verdicts — when we tell you to skip something, that stays true whether or not there is a commission attached.

Analytics

We may use privacy-respecting analytics to understand, in aggregate, how visitors use the site — for example, which guides are most read. This data is not used to identify you personally.

External links

Our articles link to third-party websites (such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, certification bodies, and course providers). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites; please review their own policies.

Children's privacy

CertNorth is intended for a general audience and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal information we hold about you. To make a request, contact us at the address below.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Email us at {{email}} or visit our contact page.

title: Contact
description: Get in touch with the CertNorth team — questions, corrections, topic suggestions, and partnership inquiries.
bodyHtml:
We'd love to hear from you — whether it's a question about a guide, a correction, a suggestion for a topic, or a partnership inquiry.

Email us

The best way to reach the CertNorth team is by email:

{{email}}

We read every message and aim to reply within a few business days.

Corrections

Found a number that's out of date or a step that no longer matches reality? Tell us which article and what you noticed. Exam prices, certification requirements, and official salary data change over time, and reader reports genuinely help us keep guides accurate.

About CertNorth

CertNorth publishes honest, officially-sourced guides to project management certifications and careers — no vendor spin. Learn more about how we research and verify in our editorial policy.
